title: Turbofan ground run
label: Cutaway Trent 970 hung from a goalpost thrust frame by a pylon and gauged load cell: inlet lip, fan cowl, swept fan blades, spinner, opened reverser sleeves, core stages, glowing combustor, exhaust cone and heat haze over a bed plate.
caption: Drag ↔ thrust (End jumps to take-off). The three spools wind up at their own speeds, the combustor and the exhaust haze grow, and the load cell reads the push: 14 kN at idle, 334 kN at take-off.
